text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I've always been completely “alone”.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Because I am... exactly the kind of girl 
you know me to be."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
The truth is, I was meant to quietly... 
alone, fade into the shadows.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: However...—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: You... you found me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Early in the morning, I woke up feeling 
the chilly air. The forecast said it would 
be cloudy all day, so while the sky wasn't 
clear, my spirits were high.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After all, starting today... full-scale 
training begins with the Umamusume I 
signed a contract with.
choice_data_list:
(Alright, let's put our all into the 
preparations.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
First, I'd like to measure your current 
abilities. Tracsen Academy is 
well-equipped, so we have every tool we 
could possibly need.
choice_data_list: （よし、張り切って準備しよう）
choice_data_list_en: (Alright, let's put our all into getting ready.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
choice_data_list:
(Next I need to bring out the hurdles 
too...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Um...
choice_data_list: （あとはハードルも出して……）
choice_data_list_en: (Then I set up the hurdles too...)

choice_data_list: （……ん？今なにか……）
choice_data_list_en: ï¼â¦â¦Hm? Did something justâ¦â¦ï¼

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...You're finally looking at me.
choice_data_list: Still...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Good morning, Trainer...
choice_data_list: スティル……！
choice_data_list_en: Still...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—She is Still in Love. Starting today, she 
is my trainee Umamusume, aiming for the 
Twinkle Series alongside me.
choice_data_list: Sorry, I didn't notice.
I'm sorry, I didn't realize.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I am fine. I am quite used to it...
choice_data_list: ごめんな、気づかなくて
ごめんね、気づかなくて
choice_data_list_en: Sorry, I didn't notice.
Sorry, I didn't notice.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
You're preparing for training, correct? 
Please allow me to assist you.
choice_data_list: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love is a reserved, somewhat 
inconspicuous Umamusume. Aside from that, 
she's an ordinary, kind girl, but—
choice_data_list: ありがとう
choice_data_list_en: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—A sudden chill ran down my spine. 
Flashing back like a bolt of lightning was 
the night I first met her...
choice_data_list: （“そう”じゃない一面も……ある）
choice_data_list_en: (She also has a side that isn't...'like that.')

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Let us devour even the moon itself.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Ahaha.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"A-ha-ha! AHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA! 
AAAAAAHHHHHHAAAAAA.........!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love's other side. That is... a 
beast-like face shown only by "instinct."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The "wild blood" dormant within her. Once 
it awakens—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Let me sip... your power!! —Until every 
drop of your blood runs dryyyy!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An otherworldly, monstrous presence 
appears. ...Yet, toward that run which 
terrifies all who behold it—
choice_data_list: (I can't help it—I'm drawn to her...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It remains burned into my mind forever, 
refusing to fade. Her run... her fierce 
spirit... that sheer dread... engraved 
deep within me—
choice_data_list: （どうしようもなく――惹かれてしまう）
choice_data_list_en: (Irresistibly—I'm drawn to her)

text_block_list.text: —Mr./Ms.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Are you all right? ...You look a little 
pale...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Yes...
choice_data_list: 大丈夫……準備、進めようか
choice_data_list_en: I'm okay... Let's get on with the preparations.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her reserved, rational side, and her 
instinctive side. With such difficult dual 
natures to control, she must have 
struggled far more than I could imagine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Now that we've formed a contract as 
Trainer and trainee, I carry a huge 
responsibility for her future. In other 
words, there's only one thing I must do—
choice_data_list:
(No matter what she's like—I'll support 
her.)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"—Well then, that will be all for today... 
Thank you for your hard work."
choice_data_list: （どんな彼女でも――支える）
choice_data_list_en: (No matter what she's like—I'll support her)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our first training session after teaming 
up ended peacefully, with no sign of her 
instincts awakening. As long as we avoid 
the "triggers," it seems everything will 
be fine.
choice_data_list: うん、また明日
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, see you tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The conditions for awakening her 
instincts... All we know right now is: 
"competing against the strong" and "a full 
moon night"—these two.
choice_data_list:
(That said, it doesn't change the fact 
that it's out of control)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love is in an unstable state. We 
will need a specialized regimen moving 
forward that accounts for every possible 
scenario.
choice_data_list: （とはいえ制御不能なことに変わりはない）
choice_data_list_en: (That said, it doesn't change the fact that it's out of control.)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
choice_data_list: （よし、ちょっと残って考えてみよう）
choice_data_list_en: (Alright, I'll stay behind a bit and think it over.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Pitter... patter... *shhhhhh*...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—While focusing on my work, before I knew 
it, the night had grown quite late. It's 
almost curfew time for the Umamusume.
choice_data_list: Whoa, and now it's raining...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fortunately, there's a spare umbrella in 
the Trainer's room. Having packed up my 
things, I turned around to head home, 
when—
choice_data_list: うわ、雨も降ってる……
choice_data_list_en: Whoa, it's raining too...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
choice_data_list: Whoa!?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I-I do apologize. I didn't mean to startle 
you...
choice_data_list: わぁっっ！？
choice_data_list_en: Waaah!?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
A little... for about an hour now. I'm 
sorry, I did knock, but...
choice_data_list: い、いつからここに……？
choice_data_list_en: S-Since when have you been here...?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
You were so focused, so... I held back to 
avoid disturbing you.
choice_data_list: Didn't you go back to the dorm?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Yes. But... it felt like you were still 
here.
choice_data_list: 寮に戻ったんじゃ？
choice_data_list_en: Didn't they head back to the dorms?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
It is a sudden rain, after all. Just to 
make sure you don't get wet, even by 
chance...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I brought an umbrella, but... Was it 
unnecessary of me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love offered a wry smile as she 
noticed the umbrella in her hand. I felt 
genuinely grateful for her kindness. But 
at the same time—
choice_data_list:
Thanks for being so thoughtful. But 
listen, Still...

Thanks for the consideration. But you see, 
Still...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Yes.
choice_data_list: 気遣いありがとう。でもな、スティル
気遣いありがとう。でもね、スティル
choice_data_list_en: Thanks for the concern. But listen, Still.
Thanks for the concern. But you see, Still.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Huh...
choice_data_list: こんなこと、しなくていいからな
こんなこと、しなくていいからね
choice_data_list_en: You don't have to do this, you know.
You don't have to do this, you know.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I-I am so terribly sorry. I've 
really caused you trouble—
choice_data_list: Because you're more important than I am.

After all, you're more important than I 
am, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
choice_data_list: だって俺より、君のほうが大切だろう
だって私より、貴方のほうが大切でしょう
choice_data_list_en: Because you matter far more than I do.
Because you matter far more than I do.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ah...
choice_data_list: 髪、少し濡れてる。……大丈夫？
choice_data_list_en: Your hair's a little wet. ...Are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes. I'm fine...
choice_data_list:
Good. I'll walk you back to the dorms, 
let's go.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ah, yes...!
choice_data_list: よかった。寮まで送るよ、行こう
choice_data_list_en: Good. I'll walk you back to the dorms. Let's go.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(...I went to pick them up, but in the 
end, they ended up seeing me off.)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: (“See ya tomorrow, Still.” ...he says.)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: (“See you tomorrow, Still.” ...she says.)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
("See you tomorrow"... Tomorrow... I'll 
get to see you again...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Fufufu...♪

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(I think something has gone wrong with me. 
Whenever I think of them... it hurts, yet 
I feel so happy.)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(...Just kidding. I've always been 
weird... Yet that person... accepted me.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Your instinct is... terrifyingly 
beautiful."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "‘Your instincts are—scarily beautiful.’"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(That detestable form of mine... this 
instinct... Only they called it 
beautiful...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(...Because you are with me. I can keep 
running... into the future.)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(In the Twinkle Series, the stage of my 
dreams... A mouthwatering race... against 
the strongest—)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...That's why I want it. Please... stay 
by my side, forever."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: F o r e v e r a n d e v e r
